description: Create a new SceneGraph node at runtime and append it as a child of an existing node via RTA createChild. Subtype must be a SceneGraph node type registered for the running scene (e.g. Label, Rectangle, Poster, Group).

fields.description: Optional initial fields to set on the new node

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

id.description: Optional id to set on the new node

parentId.description: uiElementId or scene id of the parent node

subtype.description: SceneGraph subtype to create (Label, Rectangle, Poster, Group, ...)

name: roku_create_node
